result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked continental crosswalk, curb ramps with tactile warnings, and pedestrian signals. The environment provides basic pedestrian infrastructure, though the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a multi-lane divided arterial road featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a wide grassy median that serves as a pedestrian refuge. While the crossing is clearly marked, the lack of signalization and the wide roadway geometry suggest a high-speed environment that may pose risks to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a signal, increasing the risk of multiple-threat crashes.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, straight lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds, which reduces driver reaction time and increases the severity of potential impacts.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon
interventions.description: Install a HAWK signal to provide a protected crossing phase for pedestrians across the high-volume roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add user-actuated flashing lights to the crossing signs to increase driver yield rates.

result.summary: The image shows a high-speed multi-lane arterial road with a wide grassy median and no visible pedestrian infrastructure. The complete absence of sidewalks, marked crosswalks, and pedestrian signals creates a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and along the roadway edges.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and a wide median without a designated path, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks along both sides of the roadway to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers at the intersection to manage pedestrian movements.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Modify the existing median to include a cut-through and a protected waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

result.summary: A residential intersection featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps with tactile paving. The environment is characterized by faded pavement markings, narrow sidewalks, and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines for pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may hide pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using thermoplastic material in a continental pattern to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
